CRM.rationale: Salesforce presents a compelling fundamental picture with accelerating revenue growth (Q1 FY27 +13.3% YoY to $11.13B, fastest in recent quarters), strong margin expansion (gross margin 77.6%, operating margin 20.4%, net margin 18.7%), and robust cash generation ($6.70B operating cash flow in Q1). The company maintains dominant CRM market position (#1 with 20% global share per IDC) and is seeing meaningful AI traction with Agentforce ARR reaching $1.2B in Q1 (up 205% YoY). Valuation is attractive at 19.6x trailing P/E, well below the 54x level from a year ago, and near the low end of its 16.3-55.8x range. The $1.6B VA contract win provides a credible near-term catalyst validating AI demand. However, balance sheet leverage has increased significantly (debt-to-equity 1.15x vs 0.14x a year ago, likely from Informatica acquisition), and there are legitimate concerns about security breach claims and Tableau headwinds noted by Evercore. The stock is down ~33% YTD, creating a value opportunity, but the debt increase and competitive pressures from Microsoft Dynamics temper conviction.

Security breach claims and Tableau headwinds create execution risk

The Department of Veterans Affairs awarded Salesforce a $1.6 billion ceiling contract for its AI agent products (Agentforce) over three years. Agentforce ARR reached $1.2 billion in Q1 FY2027, up 205% year-over-year.
IDC ranks Salesforce the #1 CRM vendor for the thirteenth straight year with 20.0% global share. Agentforce ARR hit $800 million in Q4 FY26, up 169%

Evercore ISI lowered its price target on Salesforce.com stock to $250 from $260 while maintaining an Outperform rating. The firm cited mixed trends with progress in Agentforce offset by headwinds in Tableau and Commerce Cloud.
Security advisory issued for Salesforce users following high profile breach claims involving groups such as ShinyHunters.
